description:
As a conference event planner, organize your upcoming feedback surveys. 

1. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!) if not already logged in.
2. Create three new Survey Groups with the following exact details:
   - Group 1: Title 'Annual Tech Summit 2024', Description 'All surveys related to the Annual Tech Summit held in Austin, TX — November 2024', Sort order 2.
   - Group 2: Title 'Global Healthcare Innovation Forum 2024', Description 'Surveys for the Global Healthcare Innovation Forum held in Boston, MA — October 2024', Sort order 1.
   - Group 3: Title 'Women in Leadership Conference 2024', Description 'Surveys for the Women in Leadership Conference held in Chicago, IL — December 2024', Sort order 3.

3. Create a new survey inside the 'Annual Tech Summit 2024' group:
   - Title: 'Post-Event Satisfaction Survey - Tech Summit 2024'
   - Set the survey to be Anonymized (Anonymized responses = Yes).

4. Add a question group 'Overall Event Experience' and a single question to this survey:
   - Code: 'Q01'
   - Text: 'How would you rate your overall experience at the Tech Summit 2024?'
   - Type: List (Radio)
   - Add 5 answer options: 1='Very Dissatisfied', 2='Dissatisfied', 3='Neutral', 4='Satisfied', 5='Very Satisfied'.

Ensure the survey is saved and assigned to the correct group.
